title: Round 14 results.json (one file per implementer, V\<X>\results.json)
description: Format of the independent re-computation of the SHAP comparison numbers of scope (i), lead 0, and of treeroute's B1 sensitivity. See V\spec\SPEC.md. Format only: it defines no statistic.
